newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-ENGLISH AND SCOTTISH FIXTURES FOR APRIL 11 TO 14.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ENGLISH AND SCOTTISH FIXTURES FOR APRIL 11 TO 14.

text.p: English and Scottish soccer fixtures for April 11 to 14:
English division two - Rothreham v Brentford.
English division three - Colchester v Swansea, Mansfield v Carlisle.
English premier league - Arsenal v Leicester, Blackburn v Manchester United, Derby v Aston Villa, Everton v Tottenham, Southampton v West Ham.

English division one - Barnsley v Charlton, Birmingham v Huddersfield, Bolton v Oxford, Norwich v Stoke, Port Vale v Oldham, Portsmouth v Tranmere, Queens Park Rangers v Grimsby, Reading v Wolverhampton, Sheffield United v Crystal Palace, Southend v Bradford, Swindon v Ipswich, West Bromwich v Manchester City.

English division two - Blackpool v Bury, Bournemouth v Gillingham, Crewe v Bristol Rovers, Millwall v Plymouth, Notts County v Wycombe, Peterborough v Preston, Shrewsbury v Wrexham, Stockport v Burnley, Walsall v Luton, Watford v York.

English division three - Brighton v Wigan, Cardiff v Chester, Exeter v Lincoln, Fulham v Northampton, Hartlepool v Cambridge, Leyton Orient v Doncaster, Rochdale v Darlington, Scarborough v Hereford, Scunthorpe v Hull, Torquay v Barnet.
Scottish F.A. Cup semifinal - Celtic v Falkirk.
Scottish premier division - Dunfermline v Hibernian, Hearts v Aberdeen, Motherwell v Raith.
Scottish division one - Airdrieonians v Dundee, East Fife v Greenock Morton, Partick v St Johnstone, St Mirren v Clydebank.
Scottish division two - Ayr v Stenhousemuir, Brechin v Livingston, Dumbarton v Clyde, Hamilton v Stranraer, Queen of the South v Berwick.
Scottish division three - Alloa v Ross County, Arbroath v Montrose, Forfar v East Stirling, Inverness v Albion, Queen's Park v Cowdenbeath.
English F.A. Cup semifinals - Wimbledon v Chelsea (at Arsenal), Middlesbrough v Chesterfield (at Manchester United).
Scottish F.A. Cup semifinal - Kilmarnock v Dundee United.
